field.label: Sequence Configuration
field.help:
Enter the sequence configuration in YAML format. Each step should have 'exec' and optionally 'matches' fields.
Example:
- exec: $hosts
- matches: has_resp
  exec: accept
- matches: qtype 65
  exec: reject 3
- exec: $cache
- matches: has_resp
  exec: accept
